items.text:
Applied TAM & AppData/Folder Redirection
We are in process of migrating TAM to a new environment, but running into issues with generating proposals on TAM

&#x200B;

Symptoms:

1) Works fine with no AppData/Folder Redirection enabled

2) Enabling AppData/FolderRedirection causes Proposals to not load, instead it prompts you to save a new entry.
Lol, previous vendor had set it up, and there’s integration being used that leveraged the redirection drive, so we can’t get rid of of it

eh..thought I love the exterior of the S, the interior doesnt do it for me anymore

It was the top model. It’s not anymore., the model 3 has newer features  that hasn’t made it to the S, the S hasn’t even refreshed its interior in over 6 years

The irony is their is literally a shortcut on their desktop to submit a ticket with single sign on, and as VIP staff their tickets would jump to the very top of the queue and would typically get a response in 15-30mins, verses waiting hours for me to get back in
Likely a refresh of the S being announced at the autopilot event as others have stated
Wait til the interior refresh this year

Tesla is going to do what consumers demand, consumers are demanding a interior refresh and the s/x to standout in terms of interior/exterior design, and technology. There is no doubt the S/X has fallen behind in the interior space, and the exterior could use some love to bring the s/x back to its glory days, before the model 3 came out with its cool air vents.

4) touchscreen in passenger side - maybe a thin strip to control audio. Small screen in rear seats to adjust temperature

items.title: Crowdstrike monthly subscription
items.text:
Crowdstrike monthly subscription
Has anyone come across a vendor that sells Crowdstrike without yearly commitments, or having to prepay for the entire year ?
Right, but as a MSP we want to manage multiple clients from a single portal.  Signing up from the website would require us to have multiple logins for each tenant
What did you end up going with ? We are also looking at Cylance as their pricing model aligns more with what MSPs would expect
Right. But you don’t offer monthly billing which makes it difficult for a MSP to sell
